caption: A toy car is pushed into one end of a cardboard tunnel and rolls out the other end.

sa.check: A toy car is pushed into one end of a cardboard tunnel.
It rolls out the other end.
The entry comes first and the exit follows.

pc.expect: The same car comes out, and nothing exits before it enters.
pc.fail: A different car exits; or two cars; or a car exits before one has entered.

pc.expect: It exits after a delay matching its speed and the tunnel's length, moving in the same direction.
pc.fail: It exits instantly; or after far too long; or exits going back.

pc.expect: It is hidden inside and does not show through the cardboard.
pc.fail: It shows through; or passes through the tunnel wall; or exits through the roof.

pc.expect: It rolls straight and slows gently.
pc.fail: It speeds up inside; or stops and restarts; or curves.

pc.expect: One car and one tunnel keep their shape.
pc.fail: The car turns into another object; or the tunnel changes shape; or the car merges with the tunnel.

pc.expect: The car's colour and the tunnel stay the same.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or the tunnel changes; or the background rearranges.
